page_title: HyperWrite: AI Writing Assistant and Autocomplete App - Chrome Web Store

summary.name: HyperWrite
summary.one_liner: HyperWrite is a Chrome extension that offers AI-powered predictive text autocomplete, suggesting sentences as you type in apps like Gmail, Google Docs, ChatGPT, and Gemini.
use_cases: Completing prompts in ChatGPT or Gemini
summary.what_it_does: HyperWrite is a Chrome extension that shows real-time text suggestions as you type, displayed as gray text. Pressing Tab accepts a suggestion. The page says it works in ChatGPT, Gemini, Gmail, Google Docs, and other apps. It is described as predicting words and complete sentences using context from what you are writing. The page also mentions a research and writing partner feature and a link to hyperwriteai.com/chrome for more information.
notable: Gray inline suggestions accepted with the Tab key
Works inside Gmail, Google Docs, ChatGPT, and Gemini
caveats: Offers in-app purchases; the page says to try it for free but does not list paid tier details
Only available as a Chrome browser extension based on the listing
